experiment.question: Can the unmodified pinned Shiu et al. whole-brain model execute its tutorial right-hemisphere sugar-stimulation experiment on the local research host and produce a structurally valid 30-trial spike result?
experiment.hypothesis: The pinned upstream source, original dependency environment and bundled FlyWire-v630 inputs can execute the official tutorial sugar-stimulation path locally without source or scientific-parameter modification.
experiment.falsifier: The exact pinned source/data cannot be executed under the declared strict environment and resource budget without modifying source, data or scientific parameters, or the produced artifact is unreadable/structurally invalid.
experiment.model: Upstream Brian2 leaky-integrate-and-fire model in model.py; unmodified; strict environment uses environment_full.yml first
experiment.task: Activate the 21 right-hemisphere sugar-sensing FlyWire neuron IDs from pinned example.ipynb and collect the model's spike output
fixed_conditions: r_poi=150 Hz from pinned executable model.py for the first tutorial call
record n_proc and platform as execution parameters
metrics: output bytes and SHA-256 for artifact integrity
experiment.compute_budget: R00 environment/data smoke precedes R01. For R01, record wall time/RAM and stop on resource exhaustion; no claim of real-time performance.
experiment.analysis_plan: Validate provenance and output schema first. Because PoissonInput is stochastic and no explicit upstream seed was observed in the inspected path, report numerical outputs as distributions/observations; do not require exact spike hashes or a preselected exact spike count. R01 only establishes local execution, not figure-level scientific reproduction.
experiment.success_criterion: All 30 requested trials complete; output is readable and structurally valid; source/data/environment receipts are complete; no source/data/scientific-parameter mutation occurred.
confounds: DRIFT-SHIU-ACTIVATION-FREQ-001: example.ipynb prose says default 200 Hz while pinned model.py defines r_poi=150 Hz
Upstream model uses stochastic PoissonInput and no explicit seed was observed in the inspected tutorial/model path
environment.yml asks for NumPy 1.24 while environment_full.yml used for original work pins NumPy 1.22.3
Changing parallel process count may affect stochastic realization and performance
This experiment does not compare biological topology against artificial/randomized controls

non_claims: This is not a topology-superiority experiment.
This is not yet a reproduction of a specific Nature figure or behavioural validation.
No package installation, dataset retrieval or simulation run is asserted.
